utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: My toaster's been acting up for weeks. I'd be grateful if your repair team could take a look at it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: A toaster! See, I knew I had to bring mine too. Maybe we can drop them off together—what day is it again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Saturday, I think. I'll be there early.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, hey Ira — just so you know, the repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on my porch. Got my tools ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, thanks for the heads up, Gus! I was planning for Saturday, so glad I ran into you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Ira — I'll have my toolbox out back if anyone needs an extra pair of pliers or a socket set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, Cleo, I think I've got it now—it's for fixing those little things around the neighborhood like squeaky doors and fences, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's right, Hana! It's a repair drive — Saturday at the community center, bring your broken stuff for fixing! I've been telling everyone about it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I want to help out. Is there anything I need to bring, like tools or snacks for the volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I think I heard something about that. What's the plan again?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It's a community event where we fix broken items instead of tossing them. I'm helping out with tools and small appliance repairs — want to join?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, that! Yeah, count me in for fixing fences or creaky doors.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure it's a repair drive? I thought someone mentioned a yard sale.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm pretty sure it's a repair drive—I heard Vik's been rounding up tools for it, not stuff for selling.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Well, if Vik's involved with tools, that does sound more like fixing things than selling them. Okay, I'll take your word for it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I think it's coming along nicely—we've got a good number of folks signed up to help out. Are you thinking of bringing something in for repair?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I've got an old clockwork radio that's been gathering dust—just want to make sure it's worth fixing before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, a clockwork radio—those are sturdy little things! I'm sure the repair team can give you a good idea of whether it's fixable. Bring it by!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey, Cleo, I’ve been hearing about this repair drive—what exactly is it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's a community event where we fix up houses on Maple Street. We're meeting at the community center Saturday morning—Gus is lending tools, so we just need to bring extra batteries for the power tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, that sounds like a good way to help out. Should I bring my own batteries, or are you collecting them?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Bo, do you have the exact address for the repair drive? I want to make sure I'm not heading to the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sorry Opal, I'm totally blanking on the address—thought it was just at the community center parking lot? You better check with someone who actually wrote it down.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Right, I'll ask around then—thanks anyway, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, the repair drive starts at 10 AM sharp—don't be late like I usually am!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I'll make sure to pass that on to everyone! See you there, Dane.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Awesome, see you there, Quinn! I'll try not to be fashionably late for once.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, and we should double-check we have a backup plan if the weather turns bad—I heard there might be rain later.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good point, I'll check the forecast.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: And what about those extension cords? If we're working in different spots, we might need more than one.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Mina! I'm glad you're here — I was hoping to ask if you could help gather some tools for Saturday's repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I can help with that. What exactly are we fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Let's start with the playground swing set — Hana mentioned the chains are frayed, so that's a priority. Can you bring some wrenches and maybe a chain link tool?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa, have you heard about the repair drive on Maple Street? They're meeting at the community center Saturday morning to fix up bikes and appliances.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh Tess, I actually just moved it to Sunday at the community center—hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Sunday works even better for me, Rosa! I'll spread the word so everyone knows about the change.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Do you know where we're supposed to gather for the repair drive? I want to be sure I'm heading to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's at the community center parking lot, near the big oak tree. I'll be there early to set up. Maybe I could use a hand?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks! I can come early to help set up. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Does anyone know where we're meeting for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Nell! Glad you asked — I keep forgetting. It's at the community center, right? I've still got that old toaster in my trunk.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's what I heard too, but let's double-check with someone who's organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Bo, I heard the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center now — just a heads up so you don't show up at the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sunday? Right, got it. What time does it start again? I'm in a hurry.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Starts at 10 AM, same as before — just a different day and spot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, um, the plan? I think it's to fix up the old community center benches and maybe some fences? Did I get that right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, that's right! And just so you know, it's been moved to Sunday at the community center. I'll help round up some folks from my side.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sunday? Yeah, Sunday works. Wait, that's tomorrow? I'd better write that down.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Tess, I hope this repair drive sticks to a proper schedule. I can't stand last-minute changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, don't you worry, Eli! They've got everything planned down at the community center on Saturday morning, bright and early.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday morning, you say? Well, that's fine by me. I'll be there with my toolbox at 7 sharp.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, Vik's definitely got tools ready—saw him hauling a box of wrenches into his garage yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so it IS about fixing appliances? I thought maybe you were talking about some kind of computer thing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Nope, it's appliances and stuff—Vik told me he's planning to help folks fix toasters, lamps, that sort of thing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, are you joining the repair drive tomorrow? We're fixing fences and doing some community upkeep.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'll be there. 10 AM, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, 10 AM sharp. Bring any tools you've got—we'll need all the help we can get.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Sam! I'm so glad you asked. We're putting together a neighborhood repair drive this Saturday — folks can bring broken stuff from sewing machines to lawn mowers, and we'll have people to help fix 'em up. It's been a great way to share skills and keep things out of the landfill.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds awesome! I've got some tools I can lend out, and I'm pretty handy with small appliances like toasters — happy to help fix those up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Sam, that's perfect! We could really use someone with your toaster-fixing skills — I'll add you to the volunteer list right now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm just worried we're missing a critical tool again, like that socket wrench from last time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you check the toolbox in the garage? That's where we usually keep the socket wrench.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I already checked the toolbox, but the set is incomplete. We really need to locate that missing piece before we get started.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Faye, are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I'll be there—I'm bringing my kids' old bikes to fix up. What about you?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I think I'll come by too—I've got some tools I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara! Actually, I just got word that the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center. Does that still work for you?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Sunday works perfectly for me! I'll just adjust my schedule and let Sam and Jules know about the change.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's great to hear, Mara! I'll update the flyers and let Kira know too. Thanks for being so flexible!
